Set or update secret fields on a vault entry

Usage: kprun set [OPTIONS] <ENTRY> [PAIRS]...

Arguments:
  <ENTRY>     Vault entry title (created if missing)
  [PAIRS]...  KEY=value pairs to set on the entry

Options:
      --stdin  Read KEY=value lines from stdin (avoids argv / shell-history exposure)
  -h, --help   Print help
